description.narrative: JRR’s mission is to strengthen accountability for international crimes and serious human rights violations, via activities that focus on sexual and gender-based violence, crimes affecting children and youths, restorative justice, and crimes affecting the environment. Its work also enhances the protection of survivors of those crimes. It does this by rostering and deploying specialised experts with experience in addressing and ending impunity for those crimes in international investigations and other justice and accountability procedures, thereby strengthening the rule of law, and by pursuing victim-centred and inclusive justice to ensure that survivors of international crimes and serious human rights violations, especially women and children, have access to justice and receive reparation for harms suffered. In 2024, JRR deployed experts across a range of developing contexts, including Colombia, Syria, Afghanistan, Haiti, Ethiopia and Sudan, and Myanmar.
